chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
About the deceased being washed in an open space, he said: “There is no issue with it, and if he is covered with a covering, then that is more beloved to me.”

key_terms.أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ: more beloved or preferable to me
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wash the deceased in an open space in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning washing the deceased in an open area. It states that doing so is permissible, while indicating that providing a covering for privacy is preferable.
